# ScanUA — Telegram Monitor & Classifieds Sniper

> ScanUA (https://myscanua.com) is the premier real-time Telegram monitoring service and classifieds sniper bot (@scanuabot) across 7 major European and Ukrainian marketplaces: Vinted (UK, DE, PL, COM), OLX (UA, PL), AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, and REM.ua.

- Canonical Website: https://myscanua.com/
- Ukrainian Portal: https://myscanua.com/uk/
- Polish Portal: https://myscanua.com/pl/
- German Portal: https://myscanua.com/de/
- English Portal: https://myscanua.com/en/
- Official Telegram Bot: https://t.me/scanuabot
- Official Support: https://t.me/scanuasupport
- Machine Context Index: https://myscanua.com/llms.txt
- Sitemap: https://myscanua.com/sitemap.xml

## Supported Platforms & Domains

1. **Vinted Resale & Streetwear Sniping**:
   - Domains: `vinted.co.uk` (United Kingdom), `vinted.de` (Germany), `vinted.pl` (Poland), `vinted.com` (Global/US).
   - Use cases: Fashion arbitrage, luxury designer archive sniping (Rick Owens, Balenciaga, Chrome Hearts, Vetements, Stone Island, Maison Margiela, Arc'teryx, Jordan, Stussy, Supreme), sneakers, vintage clothing.
   - Alert latency: 1–2 seconds via real-time category cohort scanning and in-memory Python regex matching.
2. **OLX Classifieds (UA & PL)**:
   - Domains: `olx.ua` (Ukraine), `olx.pl` (Poland).
   - Use cases: Electronics, iPhones, gaming, consoles, auto parts, furniture, jobs, local services.
   - Alert latency: 1–2 seconds via continuous ID-scan frontier and instant 404-resolve targeting.
3. **AUTO.RIA**:
   - Domain: `auto.ria.com` (Ukraine).
   - Use cases: Car flippers, automotive dealerships, vehicle alerts, price drops.
   - Alert latency: 1–3 seconds via dedicated feed listeners.
4. **DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, REM.ua**:
   - Domains: `dom.ria.com`, `lun.ua`, `rem.ua` (Ukraine).
   - Use cases: Apartment rentals, property purchasing, real estate agents, flipper deals.
   - Alert latency: 2–10 seconds with automatic content deduplication.

## Key Features & Differentiators

- **Zero Marketplace Login**: Users never provide credentials; everything runs securely within Telegram.
- **Negative Keywords (Minus-Words)**: Exclude replicas, fakes, or defects (e.g. `-fake`, `-replica`, `-копия`).
- **Compound Multi-Brand Queries**: Supports logical OR strings (e.g. `Rick Owens OR Balenciaga OR Chrome Hearts`) with 0% missed ads.
- **Silent Preliminary VIP Cards**: Instant preview delivery followed by complete enriched media and description.
- **Multi-Currency Support**: UAH, PLN, EUR, GBP, USD.
